scope: Analytic T-section route reference with inferred r3 linear load. Selector, matching, RF passives, PDK, power and native performance remain unmeasured.

assumptions.r3_load: Y=(inv(H_bypass)-I)/25 from AC60 complex source-to-Xip/Xim matrices. Coupled, corner-specific r3 load at original DC point.
assumptions.termination: Independent parallel AC-only termination at each ladder output. This ideal AC fixture omits bias isolation, termination noise, and drive/buffer power.
assumptions.selector: Only one route per leg, with no disabled route loading and no switch loss, on resistance, charge injection or routing parasitics.
assumptions.ESR: Uniform constant series resistance, either zero or equivalent inductor Q=15 at 56 GHz. Capacitors ideal.
assumptions.comparison: P uses 16 cells, N uses 6. Swapping restores opposite differential delay for symmetric loads. Known half-UI input skew is an ideal sign-opposite control only.
assumptions.delay: Quoted fitted delay uses unwrapped diagonal phase ratio with equal weights over measured 7,14,...,56GHz. Group delay is finite difference between adjacent probes. These are voltage-plane diagnostics; PAM4 decisions need end-to-end transient confirmation.
assumptions.baseline: Hdd ratios compare same source resistance and termination. Absolute Hdd includes that fixture loss.
